title: Naturality extension from identity representatives
statement: The normalization equation for arbitrary representative isomorphisms follows from the equation for identity representatives and functoriality.

source.place: naturality of the affine cohomology comparison

proof.text: Transport L.property through H^n(t.symm) to put Q(T_A C) in D_QCoh. Specialize h to its identity representative. Lift t.hom with ObjectProperty.homMk and use d.hom.naturality. Unfold the actual coordinate isomorphism to get b_(C,t)=b_(C,id) followed by Gamma_A H^i(t); map the composite through restriction of scalars and tilde and reassociate.

Read AffineDerivedUnitHomologyIsIso, QCohAcyclicDerivedPushforwardCohomology and AffineDerivedCohomology. The first concerns affine sections; the latter comparisons state existence without the normalization required here. No duplicate identity-normalized affine pushforward statement.

theorem affineTildePushforwardCohomologyNormalization_extend
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : B →+* A) (i : ℤ)
    (d : affineDerivedCohomologyModules A i ⋙
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ ⋙ affinePushforwardTilde B) ≅
      (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι ⋙
      schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of B)).toRingedSpace)) i)
    (h : ∀ C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ,
      affineTildePushforwardIdentityNormalization A B φ i d C) :
    ∀ (L : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A)))
      (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
      (t : DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((affinePushforwardTilde A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≅ L.obj),
      affineTildePushforwardNormalizationEquation A B φ i d L C t
